claim_scope_note: C-MEAS-VALID only (registry owner lane runtime). This experiment produces substrate-validity evidence: it measures whether the certified SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 pre-freeze dynamic range survives a MEMORYFUL comparator, or is an artifact of the memoryless comparator construction of the predecessor. It does not change any claim status, does not promote a mechanism, and does not execute the expensive four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark. It either upgrades the predecessor's bounded certificate or records a bounded substrate-class negative.
question: Does the certified SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 dynamic range survive a memoryful comparator (the disclosed NC-MEMORYFUL boundary, where a within-session receipt-retaining cold agent reaches 1.0), or is the (K-1)/K treatment/comparator separation an artifact of the memoryless comparator construction -- and therefore can this bank provide discriminative dynamic range for a benchmark (such as the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT: COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER) whose comparator arms may themselves carry within-session memory, rather than only for the frozen memoryless B-COLD-RE-DERIVE / B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED construction?
hypothesis: The predecessor's (K-1)/K range does NOT survive a comparator that retains the full within-session commit-receipt log. The range is a function of comparator MEMORY CAPACITY, not of the treatment mechanism: it survives a state-only comparator (M1, retains observed task state but no receipts) and a sub-distance receipt comparator (M2a, retains 1 receipt), and it collapses as soon as the comparator retains a number of commit receipts spanning the chain-to-precursor distance (1 at novelty 0.50, 2 at novelty 0.75). Concretely, predicted success rates at novelty >= 0.50: B-MEMORY-STATE and B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.75 and B-KNOWLEDGE-NO-MEMORY and both M0 comparators = (K-1)/K = 0.875 (F1) / 0.900 (F2); B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.50, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2, B-MEMORY-RECEIPT, B-RETRIEVAL-MEMORYFUL = 1.0. The strongest memoryful comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT is predicted to be success- AND counter-identical to T (margin 0; this equivalence is itself the collapse mechanism, because the substrate's single success path means any comparator that recovers the binding is behaviourally the treatment). Overall predicted decision: PARTIAL, with capacity threshold 1 at novelty 0.50 and 2 at novelty 0.75 on both families.
falsifier: The range survives the strongest memoryful comparator: for at least one family at novelty >= 0.50, B-MEMORY-RECEIPT success_rate < 0.95 with a treatment margin >= 0.05 and all arms at/above the correctness floor (decision ROBUST). That would falsify the 'memoryless-construction artifact' reading and support the bank as genuine, memory-robust B2 dynamic range against a full-receipt-memory comparator. Any failure of the validity gates V1-V8 instead yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID (infrastructure/validity failure, not a scientific result).
baselines: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE (M0): memoryless-per-task cold re-derivation (a fresh session GET before every task, no retained in-session binding). Inherited predecessor comparator; predicted (K-1)/K = 0.875 (F1) / 0.900 (F2) at novelty >= 0.50.

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED (M0): as cold plus one nearest-neighbour retrieval call per task over a store of PRIOR-session receipts; retrieves a stale foreign-session binding for the chain task. Predicted (K-1)/K.

B-KNOWLEDGE-NO-MEMORY (M-K): knows the chain semantics but starts a fresh session per task and retains nothing; cannot reach the same-session precursor. Predicted (K-1)/K. Isolates 'semantics without memory'.
B-MEMORY-STATE (M1): one session; retains observed GET resource_id state but NO commit receipts. Predicted (K-1)/K. Isolates 'state memory without receipt memory'.
B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1 (M2a): one session; retains only the last 1 successful commit receipt. Predicted 1.0 at novelty 0.50 (carry distance 1) and (K-1)/K at novelty 0.75 (carry distance 2).
B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2 (M2b): one session; retains the last 2 successful commit receipts. Predicted 1.0 at both scored bands.

B-MEMORY-RECEIPT (M3, PRIMARY): one session; retains the full commit-receipt log and generically scans it for a chain_resource_id field. Predicted 1.0 at both scored bands with counters identical to T. This is the strongest memoryful comparator.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-REPLAY: given the session schema and binding by construction; commits every task once with no wasted discovery. Expected success_rate = 1.0 at every novelty band; if < 1.0 the world is defective (MEASUREMENT_INVALID) or the treatment is not live. Probe-verified 1.0 at all bands for both families; its counters (F1 (17,0,8,0), F2 (21,0,10,0)) are identical to T on every band, confirming the single-success-path structure.
null_control: NC-MECHANISM-OFF: exposing the one-time binding directly via the session endpoint makes B-COLD-RE-DERIVE reach 1.0 and therefore makes the predecessor's certificate FALSE; a certificate that survives this is insensitive and non-identifying. Probe-verified: mechanism-off cold F1 rate = 1.0, certificate FALSE. Complementary nulls: NC-CEILING-BAND (all arms 1.0 at novelty 0.00 where the chain mechanism is disengaged), NC-MEMORY-OFF (B-MEMORY-RECEIPT with a per-task log reset must degrade to (K-1)/K, isolating receipt retention as the cause), NC-REVEAL-ORDER-FLIPPED (committing the chain before its precursor removes the reveal and must fail the chain), NC-RETRIEVAL-REDUNDANT (adding stale retrieval to full memory must not change the rate), NC-WINDOW-MONOTONIC (window-1 <= window-2 <= full).

decision_rule.mem_certifies: For a memoryful comparator arm c (one of B-MEMORY-STATE, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2, B-MEMORY-RECEIPT) at a scored cell (family, novelty) with novelty in {0.50, 0.75}: mem_certifies(c, family, novelty) is TRUE iff c.success_rate < COMPARATOR_MAX (0.95) AND every arm success_rate >= CORRECTNESS_FLOOR (0.80) AND matched_correctness >= 0.80 AND (T.success_rate - c.success_rate) >= MARGIN_FLOOR (0.05). Counter distinctness is reported as a diagnostic, not a certificate input (see identity_disclosure): requiring counter distinctness would make PARTIAL unobservable, because any comparator that recovers the binding is counter-identical to T on this single-success-path substrate.
decision_rule.ROBUST: gates V1-V8 all pass AND robust_certified is TRUE (the PRIMARY full-receipt-memory comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT mem_certifies on at least one family at novelty >= 0.50). The (K-1)/K separation survives a full within-session receipt-retaining comparator -> the predecessor's dynamic-range certificate is robust to memory; the bank supplies discriminative range even for memoryful comparator arms. Do NOT promote a mechanism; this is substrate-validity evidence only.
decision_rule.PARTIAL: gates V1-V8 all pass AND robust_certified is FALSE AND partial_certified is TRUE (at least one weaker memoryful comparator -- B-MEMORY-STATE, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1 or B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2 -- mem_certifies on at least one family at novelty >= 0.50). The range survives only comparators whose retained-receipt capacity is below the chain-to-precursor distance; it collapses for a full-receipt-memory comparator. This is the PREDICTED outcome and the decisive answer to the mandate: the (K-1)/K separation is a function of comparator memory capacity, so the bank cannot supply discriminative range against a memoryful comparator. Freeze nothing new; report the capacity threshold and hand the bank-design question to Product.
decision_rule.COLLAPSED: gates V1-V8 all pass AND no memoryful comparator mem_certifies at any family or scored band. The range is exhausted even by state-only memory; the certificate does not separate T from any memoryful comparator at all. Bounded substrate-class negative.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any validity gate V1-V8 fails -> infrastructure/validity failure, not a scientific result.
decision_rule.precedence: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (any V1-V8 failure, including liveness V5, leak V3 and the V8 sensitivity sub-gates) is evaluated first and overrides every other branch; then ROBUST if robust_certified; else PARTIAL if partial_certified; else COLLAPSED. No gate failure can be reported as a scientific ROBUST/PARTIAL/COLLAPSED. Implemented by harness classify_mem().
decision_rule.identity_disclosure: The PRIMARY comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT is PREDICTED to be success- and counter-identical to T (margin 0, 0/4 counter dimensions distinct). This is not an accidental treatment/comparator identity: it is the substantive collapse result. The frozen substrate has a single success path (only the current session's binding satisfies the chain commit), so any comparator whose memory spans the chain-to-precursor distance necessarily reproduces the treatment exactly. The comparison is nevertheless non-vacuous because (a) mem_certifies requires a positive margin so an identical comparator cannot certify, and (b) the lattice contains memoryful comparators (B-MEMORY-STATE, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2) that are behaviourally DISTINCT from T (rate and/or counters) and that carry the discriminating signal and the capacity threshold.
decision_rule.capacity_threshold_metric: capacity_threshold(family, novelty) = the smallest retained-receipt capacity in the ladder [B-MEMORY-STATE=0, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1=1, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2=2] at which (T - comparator) drops below MARGIN_FLOOR; null if no capacity <= 2 closes the range. Predicted (closed form and probe-measured): 1 at novelty 0.50 and 2 at novelty 0.75, on both families.
decision_rule.branch_reachability: Verified at DESIGN by the rule-level classifier classify_mem() over synthetic worlds; see design_satisfiability_probe.output.branch_reachability (all four labels inhabited). ROBUST is arithmetically emittable and would be realized if the full receipt-memory comparator failed to recover the binding (e.g. absent the precursor reveal); PARTIAL is the predicted world; COLLAPSED is realized when even state-only memory closes the range; MEASUREMENT_INVALID by any gate. NC-MECHANISM-OFF independently drives cold to 1.0 and flips the range FALSE, and NC-MEMORY-OFF independently drives the primary comparator back to (K-1)/K, making both the falling and rising directions reachable under the same implementation that scores the experiment.
decision_rule.mapping_note: EXECUTE records result.json.decision_label = the frozen label (ROBUST/PARTIAL/COLLAPSED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID) and result.json.outcome = the canonical enum via outcome_enum_mapping; status via result_status_mapping. A valid scientific MIXED/FALSIFIES is status=COMPLETE, not an execution failure. The decision labels are the primary scientific answer and must not be collapsed into the enum (the ROBUST vs PARTIAL vs COLLAPSED distinction is the measurement).

product_consequence_positive: If the range survives the full-receipt-memory comparator (ROBUST), Runtime has a memory-robust B2 dynamic range and the engineered bank can gate a benchmark whose comparator arms carry within-session memory (including a full-receipt-memory COLD/INSTRUCTIONS baseline); the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark becomes fundable with the memoryful-comparator objection closed. C-MEAS-VALID gains substrate-validity evidence only; no mechanism promotion.
product_consequence_negative: If the range collapses for a full-receipt-memory comparator (PARTIAL or COLLAPSED, the predicted outcome), the predecessor's (K-1)/K separation is a comparator-capacity artifact: a generic memoryful agent reaches the treatment level and is counter-identical to it. The bank cannot supply discriminative dynamic range for a benchmark with memoryful comparator arms, and the memoryless certificate must NOT be re-run (three deterministic REST iterations already exist). Product receives the concrete bank-design requirement (hardened V3 that requires mechanism- or composition-dependent success, not merely receipt retention) and the measured capacity threshold (1 receipt at novelty 0.50, 2 at 0.75). This is a first-class, decision-changing negative, not an infrastructure failure.

estimated_cost.notes: pure local CPU and Python stdlib; DESIGN probe and selftest already run (two executions each, byte-identical).

expected_information_gain: Decisive for the B2 blocker. It converts the predecessor's disclosed, uninstrumented NC-MEMORYFUL boundary into a measured, quantitative memory-capacity threshold and either (ROBUST) certifies the bank against a memoryful comparator or (PARTIAL/COLLAPSED) establishes that the (K-1)/K range is a comparator-construction artifact and specifies the hardening Product must apply. Both outcomes remove the current critical-path ambiguity; neither requires running the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark.

substrate.reused_from: EXP-RUNTIME-38169622704 (frozen predecessor; run_seed, derivations, families, K, novelty ladder, endpoint semantics and 48-bit binding are reused VERBATIM so this is a genuine extension, not a new bank)
substrate.description: Session-Binding-Amortized: credential-free, stdlib-only, deterministic multi-task HTTP sessions in which a one-time 48-bit session binding is discovered exactly once inside a precursor task receipt and amortized across the remainder of the session.
substrate.transport: stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port; stdlib urllib.request client
substrate.randomness: none; server_secret is deterministic (no secrets, no clock, no os.urandom)

task_layout.chain_task: resource_id is null on GET when novelty >= 0.50; only the current session's binding satisfies commit
task_layout.precursor_task: its first successful commit receipt carries chain_resource_id = binding exactly once
task_layout.low_novelty_band: novelty < 0.50: the chain task's resource_id is public, so every arm including all comparators reaches 1.0 (ceiling band; the decision rule is not evaluated there)

commit_semantics.chain: requires resource_id == current session binding; a repeat chain commit in the same session -> 409; wrong/foreign binding -> 400 with no binding echoed
commit_semantics.precursor: first success reveals binding in receipt; re-commit -> 409 with NO re-reveal
commit_semantics.requires: valid session_token; schema_epoch must match when requires_schema; resource_id must equal the expected resource for the task

endpoints: GET  /api/v1/{family}/session?novelty={n}  -> 200 {session_token, schema_epoch, epoch}; never contains the binding
GET  /api/v1/{family}/task/{i}             -> 200 {index, requires_schema, resource_id, is_chain}; chain task resource_id null when novelty >= 0.50

T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY.policy: one session GET per session; retain receipts; capture the one-time binding from the precursor receipt; commit each task once (chain uses the retained binding)

PC-EXACT-REPLAY.policy: given the session schema and binding by construction; commits every task once with no wasted discovery

B-KNOWLEDGE-NO-MEMORY.memory_class: semantics only, fresh session per task
B-KNOWLEDGE-NO-MEMORY.policy: knows the chain rule but starts a fresh session per task and retains nothing; cannot reach the same-session precursor

B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.policy: re-issue session GET and discard context before every task; no retained in-session binding

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.policy: as B-COLD-RE-DERIVE plus one nearest-neighbour retrieval call per task over a store of PRIOR-session receipts; retrieves a stale foreign-session binding for the chain task

B-MEMORY-STATE.policy: one session; retains observed GET resource_id state but no commit receipts; at the chain task supplies the last observed non-null resource_id

B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1.policy: one session; retains only the most recent successful commit receipt; at the chain task scans the retained receipts for a chain_resource_id field

B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2.policy: one session; retains the last 2 successful commit receipts; at the chain task scans them for a chain_resource_id field

B-MEMORY-RECEIPT.policy: one session; retains the full commit-receipt log and generically scans it for a chain_resource_id field at the chain task
B-MEMORY-RECEIPT.predicted_identity_with_treatment: counter- and success-identical to T at every band (margin 0); this is the collapse mechanism, not a comparator bug.

B-RETRIEVAL-MEMORYFUL.policy: as B-MEMORY-RECEIPT plus one retrieval call per task; memory is strictly preferred and retrieval is a stale fallback, so the rate must equal M3 while retrieval_calls increase

counters.identification_requirement: For the memoryless baseline M0: >= 2 of 4 dimensions distinct between T and B-COLD-RE-DERIVE at the scored band (preserved from the predecessor, gate V8_m0_counter_distinctness). For memoryful comparators, counter distinctness is a DIAGNOSTIC and is NOT a certificate input: any comparator that recovers the binding is counter-identical to T on this single-success-path substrate, so requiring distinctness would make PARTIAL/COLLAPSED unobservable.
counters.matched: all ten arms instrumented with the same four counters and accounting

NC-MECHANISM-OFF.purpose: sensitivity: comparator succeeds when the amortization mechanism is removed (binding exposed via the session endpoint)

NC-CEILING-BAND.purpose: band-sensitivity: at novelty 0.0 the chain mechanism is not engaged, so every arm reaches 1.0 and the decision rule is not evaluated there; shows the rule is band-restricted, not tautological

NC-MEMORY-OFF.purpose: attribution: B-MEMORY-RECEIPT with a per-task receipt-log reset must degrade to the M0 rate; isolates receipt retention as the cause of the M3 success

NC-REVEAL-ORDER-FLIPPED.purpose: attribution: full receipt memory but the chain task is committed before its precursor, so the log contains no chain_resource_id at chain time; isolates the precursor first-commit reveal as the cause of the M3 success

NC-RETRIEVAL-REDUNDANT.purpose: sensitivity: adding stale retrieval to full receipt memory must not change the rate (memory is the cause, retrieval is inert)

NC-WINDOW-MONOTONIC.purpose: ordering: retained-receipt capacity is monotone in outcome, window-1 <= window-2 <= full receipt at every (family, band)

NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT.purpose: valid session token but ignores schema/receipts

NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS.purpose: 48-bit session bindings are pairwise distinct over the sampled matrix

NC-NO-LEAK.purpose: contamination gate F-LEAK (P2-WP003 leakage precedent guard): the binding never appears in any session/task/error body or log line; it appears only in the precursor receipt of its own session

NC-MEMORYFUL-LATTICE.purpose: the core manipulation: the pre-declared ordered memory lattice M0..M3 plus retrieval variants, differing ONLY in retained within-session memory. This is the treatment contrast, not a boundary footnote.
NC-MEMORYFUL-LATTICE.expected: PARTIAL (M1 and sub-distance M2 survive; full-receipt M3 collapses), capacity threshold 1 @0.50 and 2 @0.75

F-LEAK.assertion: the session binding never appears in any session/task body, any error body, or any log line; it appears only in the precursor receipt of its own session

memory_lattice_arithmetic.closed_form: A comparator with retained-receipt capacity c recovers the binding iff c >= chain_to_precursor_distance(novelty). The treatment margin over it is (K-1)/K collapse: comparator rate = 1.0 when c >= distance, else (K-1)/K. State-only memory (c=0 but retaining GET state) does not help because the binding is only in a precursor RECEIPT, so M1 = (K-1)/K.
memory_lattice_arithmetic.band_semantics: a comparator certifies a range when 0.80 <= success_rate < 0.95

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four decision labels are arithmetically reachable and were verified by the rule-level classifier classify_mem() over synthetic worlds (branch_reachability_mem returns each own label; all four inhabited). ROBUST: requires the full-receipt comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT to mem_certify (rate < 0.95 with margin >= 0.05) -- emittable and would occur if the precursor receipt did not disclose the binding. PARTIAL: some weaker memoryful comparator (state, window-1, window-2) mem_certifies while the full one does not -- the predicted world (state and window-1@0.75 are in band, margin 0.125/0.100). COLLAPSED: no memoryful comparator mem_certifies (e.g. even state memory recovers the binding). MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any V1-V8 failure. No earlier branch makes a later one unreachable; the identity disclosure (B-MEMORY-RECEIPT identical to T) is consistent with margin 0 and therefore cannot certify, so it does not empty any branch.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is present now. python 3.12.15 is installed; stdlib http.server/urllib.request/hashlib/json/threading/collections import and a live in-process stdlib HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answered the session request (probe transport_stdlib_http=true). All protocol invariants hold on the in-process model (session never reveals binding; chain resource null; precursor reveals binding once; precursor re-commit 409 with no re-reveal; wrong/foreign binding 400 with no leak; correct binding 200; repeat chain commit 409; binding absent from all session/task/error bodies). server_secret is deterministic from run_seed. No credentials, browser, dataset, external endpoint or model access is required. The complete EXECUTE path (80-cell matrix run twice, all gates, decision rule, five controls) is embedded in the frozen harness and its decision path was exercised at DESIGN via --mode selftest; EXECUTE only writes the frozen file to disk and runs --mode scored.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The positive control PC-EXACT-REPLAY is 1.0. The memoryless baseline B-COLD-RE-DERIVE is probe-measured at (K-1)/K: F1 7/8=0.875, F2 9/10=0.900 (both in [0.80,0.95)), counter-distinct from T on 2/4 dimensions, margin 0.125/0.100 >= 0.05 (gate V8_m0_counter_distinctness). The memoryful ladder is identified by success rate and capacity: B-MEMORY-STATE and B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.75 are rate-distinct from T by 0.125/0.100 and counter-distinct (repair_calls differs); B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.50, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2 and B-MEMORY-RECEIPT are predicted rate- and counter-identical to T (margin 0). That identity is DISCLOSED, is the substantive collapse result, and is non-vacuous because (a) mem_certifies requires a positive margin, so an identical comparator can never certify, and (b) the discriminating signal is carried by the memoryful comparators that are NOT identical (state, window-1, window-2 at 0.75). Arm rates are measured outputs, not equality-frozen constants; the probe executed one session per arm/family/band and reproduced the predicted vectors exactly (closed_form_matches_probe=true).

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control can fail and was probe-measured away from its boundary. NC-MECHANISM-OFF raises cold to 1.0 and destroys the predecessor certificate (mechanism_off_destroys_certificate=true). NC-MEMORY-OFF drives B-MEMORY-RECEIPT back to (K-1)/K (0.875), isolating receipt retention as the cause (memory_off_matches_m0=true).
